integrated.title: EWI-3R: EW counterterm lowering at scale
integrated.detail: the model compiler's kernel-equivalence proofs run natively and in parallel (rusticol model_proofs, the Python stage the oracle: counterterm model IR equal); one reference pair per Laurent coefficient, shared Horner schemes; the target's counterterm lowering ~26 s cold (26.8 / 26.4 s, 11.1 s warm on 8 threads, 13,403 kernels unchanged) against 259 s before, 8.4 % of the G_mu g g > t t~ EW generation (criterion < 20 %, user 2026-10-28); non-polynomial or below-eps^-2 coupling terms refused when reachable (CountertermCouplingError); new native build

integrated.title: EWI-7b: Lorentz Epsilon lowered
integrated.detail: UFO Lorentz Epsilon lowered (dense Levi-Civita tree kernels = ALOHA; sign = MadLoop to 1e-12 per Laurent coefficient); one root-closure reading sign for every fermionless vertex (genericity audit 2 G2-M7); Goldstone-vector mixing sign from the tree engine's momenta, confirmed against MadLoop's counterterm selection (<= 4.4e-14 on g t > t t t~ QED); [U2] anomalous vetoes (a veto that breaks a doublet) refused by default with a recorded override (allow_anomalous_veto)

integrated.title: Typed refusals of genericity audit 2
integrated.detail: listed, typed generation refusals for every silent-wrong-value path of genericity audit 2 (G2-M1 colour-accuracy-nc-exact, G2-M4 plane-mismatch, G2-m4 external-photon alpha(0) at export, G2-m1 representation-changing fermion lines), visible in the dry run; one plane-compile entry point; plans the guards do not refuse keep their bytes; new native build

integrated.title: SDK v4 parameter parity
integrated.detail: one parameter rule in the Python API, the stored-process view, V2Runtime, the Rust SDK and the C/C++/Fortran clients: ASCII decimal values checked before names, unknown, generation-fixed (naming who fixed them) and scale parameters refused with typed errors (genericity audit 2 G2-M2, m3, m7, m8); scale-dependent batches partitioned by scale; new native build

integrated.title: EWI-5: lepton lines through the loop
integrated.detail: arbitrary lepton and colour-singlet fermion lines in the loop and at the root (Koszul signs, one reading-sign rule and one fermion classifier from the tree engine; G2-M5, G2-M6); Bhabha against MadLoop, g g > t t~ e- e+ (EW) against three providers, e- e+ > t t~ h against Recola; MadLoop's omitted R2_G0tt_b shown from its own output and with Recola; photon-only QED on loop_qcd_qed_sm refused (veto-unlabelled-counterterms; full EW on that model works)
